summary: Explored decision formation (election/pre-vote, commitment quorum) and authority transitions (configuration change, commit visibility, leader lease) in the captured hashicorp/raft snapshot. Ran the snapshot's own package tests in an isolated native workspace: the only non-network failure was a single load-time TestRaft_HasExistingState 'peer mismatch' after AddVoter, which did not reproduce on rerun or in an isolated AddVoter reproduction (~1ms propagation). Recorded two sourced Behaviors (leader append-time latest-configuration + commitment voter-set update; AddNonvoter retaining an existing member's suffrage), one investigation with a bounded discriminator, an unresolved interpretation with no defect asserted, and the rebuilt AddVoter config-visibility harness for controller execution.
